title: FlowVLA: Learning Flow-Aware Physical Completion for Quantitative Robotic Pouring
title_zh: FlowVLA：学习流感知的物理完成度用于定量机器人倒水
abstract: During steady pouring, images and robot pose may remain nearly unchanged while transferred mass accumulates, making the return decision ambiguous for a whole-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy. We present FlowVLA, which separates motor generation from physical-completion estimation. A shared $π_{0.5}$ action expert learns approach, pour, and return with boundary-aware supervision. A target-independent estimator fuses visual, joint, wrist-wrench, and recurrent force-belief histories to maintain an estimate of transferred mass. The controller initiates return when this estimate plus predicted residual outflow reaches the requested mass. In coffee-pot/water experiments, FlowVLA achieves 13.1 g goal-balanced mean absolute error (MacroMAE), lower than all tested VLA baselines. Across all attempts, 53.7% both complete the task and finish within +/-10% of the requested mass. The same model interpolates to held-out 150/250-g targets without retraining. Independently trained models further evaluate the formulation in three additional container-fluid settings.
abstract_zh: 在稳定倒水过程中，图像和机器人位姿可能几乎不变，但转移的质量却在累积，这使得整体任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的返回决策变得模糊。我们提出FlowVLA，将运动生成与物理完成度估计分离。共享的$π_{0.5}$动作专家通过边界感知监督学习接近、倾倒和返回。一个与目标无关的估计器融合视觉、关节、腕部力觉和循环力信念历史，以维持对转移质量的估计。当该估计加上预测的残余流出达到请求质量时，控制器启动返回。在咖啡壶/水实验中，FlowVLA实现了13.1克目标平衡平均绝对误差（MacroMAE），低于所有测试的VLA基线。在所有尝试中，53.7%既完成任务又达到请求质量的±10%以内。同一模型无需重新训练即可插值到保留的150/250克目标。独立训练的模型进一步在三个额外的容器-流体设置中评估该公式。
tldr_zh: FlowVLA分离运动与物理估计，实现精准倒水。
cover_zh: 倒水时图像几乎不变？FlowVLA靠力觉历史精准控量
